2. **Sample bias:** Grinder evaluated 432 combos (Stage 1) → 324 (Stage 2) → 155 (Stage 3) → 5 keepers. High selection bias risk; top keeper likely overfit to noise in-sample.

4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (grinder used sniper_real_fills_grinder but OP-20 disclosure 4 requires validation on top 3 J days; not performed per output).
5. **Failure modes:**
